title: A hypothetical portfolio contains different decisions
method: Synthetic initial portfolio: 8+7+5+4+3+3=30. Separate first-wave effort=4×12+2×20+20 foundation+10 contingency=118 engineer-days. Neither mix nor effort is a benchmark.
alt: A hypothetical portfolio contains different decisions: Rehost 8 applications, Replatform 7 applications, Refactor 5 applications, Replace 4 applications, Retire 3 applications, Retain 3 applications. Illustrative inputs.
